warmReuse.reason: P2 HTTP unconditionally creates a fresh store and instance per request; the pooling branch requires targets_p3.

transport.encoding: UTF-8 JSON generated protobuf serde, not protobuf binary or gRPC
transport.hostIdSource: exact single private-host heartbeat.id, checked against subject suffix
transport.requestReply: SUB a fresh _INBOX subject, flush using PING/PONG, PUB subject inbox byteLength CRLF json CRLF; bounded MSG reader handles PING/INFO/-ERR

artifacts.registry: fresh stock zot minimal, bound only to 127.0.0.1
artifacts.startImage: same localhost repository pinned to the actual returned OCI manifest digest
artifacts.cache: fresh --oci-cache-dir populated by genuine OCI pull; never fabricate scoped cache entries
artifacts.ambientCredentials: fresh DOCKER_CONFIG containing empty auths plus isolated XDG and explicit empty wash user config; no account login

futurePrivateScope.nats: fresh loopback-only core NATS; no cluster/leafnode/account import, no existing NATS state
futurePrivateScope.zot: fresh own storage directory, no registry extensions/sync/proxy/auth integration
futurePrivateScope.wash: pinned existing stock wash2.11.0; fresh user config/XDG/DOCKER_CONFIG/OCI cache/scratch; only explicit app/cache allowed-host-paths
futurePrivateScope.ownership: all future processes under original owned monitor, finite readiness/RPC/HTTP deadlines, complete raw streams and TERM/KILL cleanup; no launch under this plan
